Topic                 Item      Checklist item description                                                                                                                                               Reported on Line

Title                  1        The diagnosis or intervention of primary focus followed by the words “case report” . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                   L1-2

Key Words              2        2 to 5 key words that identify diagnoses or interventions in this case report, including "case report" . . .                                                              L20

Abstract              3a        Introduction: What is unique about this case and what does it add to the scientific literature? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                           L22-26

(no references)       3b        Main symptoms and/or important clinical findings . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .            L28-34
3c        The main diagnoses, therapeutic interventions, and outcomes . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                         L31-36
3d        Conclusion—What is the main “take-away” lesson(s) from this case? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                               L37-40

Introduction           4        One or two paragraphs summarizing why this case is unique (may include references) . . . . . . . . . . . .                                                                L41-53

Patient Information   5a        De-identified patient specific information. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                         L55-66
5b        Primary concerns and symptoms of the patient. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                     L67-68
5c        Medical, family, and psycho-social history including relevant genetic information . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                                       L55-66

Clinical Findings      6        Describe significant physical examination (PE) and important clinical findings. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                              L68-69, L79-80

Timeline               7        Historical and current information from this episode of care organized as a timeline . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                                       L67-98

Diagnostic            8a        Diagnostic testing (such as PE, laboratory testing, imaging, surveys). . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                       L68-75,L79-95
Assessment
8b        Diagnostic challenges (such as access to testing, financial, or cultural) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                       L119-120
8c        Diagnosis (including other diagnoses considered) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                       L81-96
8d        Prognosis (such as staging in oncology) where applicable . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                L55-56
